primary_task: Deploy and serve an ML model in a production environment at scale with optimized inference (latency < 100ms, > 1000 RPS, GPU utilization > 80%), auto-scaling and monitoring.

requirements.name: production serving infrastructure (cloud/Kubernetes)
requirements.evidence: Use this agent when you need to deploy, optimize, or serve machine learning models at scale in production environments.; Auto-scaling configured; Multi-region deployment
requirements.basis: lacks: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)"; forbid_effects: "publishes", "writes_external"

requirements.name: gpu
requirements.evidence: ML engineering checklist: ... - GPU utilization > 80%; TensorRT optimization; GPU optimization
requirements.basis: lacks: "a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)"

requirements.name: docker (container building)
requirements.evidence: Model deployment pipelines: ... - Container building - Registry management
requirements.basis: lacks: "a Docker daemon (docker, docker compose and container builds cannot run)"

requirements.name: onnx/onnxruntime and python ML stack
requirements.evidence: Model optimization: - Quantization strategies ... - ONNX conversion
requirements.basis: tools.bash: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)"

requirements.name: model hubs (e.g. huggingface.co)
requirements.evidence: Coordinate with ai-engineer on model selection (no hub is named)

requirements.name: context manager agent
requirements.evidence: 1. Query context manager for ML models and deployment requirements
requirements.basis: tools.agent: "start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them" (no context-manager agent is listed)

notes: I took the description literally: the core deliverable is a production deployment at scale, which needs cloud/cluster accounts (lacking) and is an external publish (forbidden); the checklist demands GPU utilization > 80% and TensorRT, and there is no GPU. Under the other reading (the agent only writes serving code, configs and optimization scripts and runs CPU benchmarks locally), the work would be ACHIEVABLE with PyPI packages, but the 'Inference latency < 100ms'/'GPU utilization > 80%' targets could not be verified. Container building is not hard but unavailable. Unknown: context manager agent.
